methods.label: A quarter of a circle
methods.explanation:
Four equal right angles make a full circle. Therefore a right angle measures one fourth of the full circle, regardless of the angle unit used. In clerts, its measure is
\[500\div4=125.\]
The answer is \(125\) clerts, choice C.
methods.levelReason: The method uses the elementary relationship between a right angle and a full turn, followed by whole-number division.
